environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with default task definition. Container runs with default Linux capabilities. Service is exposed via an Application Load Balancer with no additional rule groups. The ALB forwards WebSocket upgrade requests directly to the container on port 4000. No network policies restrict cross-origin WebSocket connections. Task role has basic ECR pull and CloudWatch permissions.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF attached
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
config.websocket_handling: ALB passes Upgrade headers directly to target
